name: log-classify
description: Classify a single log line or short log excerpt by category, severity, and whether it warrants human action. State: the raw log line(s) as plain text.

category.instructions: What kind of log entry is this?

criteria.error: an exception, stack trace, or explicit failure
criteria.warning: a recoverable problem or a deprecation notice
criteria.security: auth failures, access violations, suspicious activity

severity.instructions: How severe is this log entry?
criteria: low: worth noting, no immediate action
critical: needs immediate attention, likely user-facing impact

actionable.instructions: Does this log entry describe something a human should act on (investigate, fix, or escalate), as opposed to routine, expected, or already-handled noise?

criteria.true: warrants a human looking at it
